principle: AIRBORNE CLEARANCE IS SHAPE DEBT, NOT A ROOT IMPULSE: compact under an overhead limit on one ballistic arc; if the body unfolds late, the landing must pay that delay through palm-first support, foot acquisition, deep tripod compression, hand release, rebound lag, and displaced re-entry.

rig.reconstruction_note: Each decisive pose stores a complete generic biped joint layout as root-relative ASCII controls. The overhead plane is a synthetic abstract constraint marker. No source silhouette or choreography is reproduced.

compile.connector: deterministic eased joint interpolation only between authored keys; support/contact semantics change only at authored key boundaries
compile.renderer: monospace ASCII-only rasterization for MP4; no source pixels

keys.label: OFFSET_LEFT_LOAD
keys.causal_role: asymmetric left-leg coil stores a low forward-right launch while the right side stays long
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root sinks left/back over a single trusted foot; shoulders counter-cant against intended rightward travel

keys.label: CANTED_SUPPORT_BREAK
keys.causal_role: left support drives up-right and releases before the torso can square
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root rises sharply and advances; no support remains after the authored break

keys.label: OPEN_RISE
keys.causal_role: body opens into rise before the overhead-clearance task begins
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root climbs forward on one ballistic arc; limbs spread to establish a broad pre-task silhouette

keys.label: EARLY_CLEARANCE_READ
keys.causal_role: head, shoulders, and task-side hand read the overhead limit early without contacting it while the root still rises
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues upward-right; local upper-body shape begins to fold without changing the root force budget

keys.label: CEILING_TUCK_APEX
keys.causal_role: a sharp asymmetric pike/tuck buys overhead clearance at the apex instead of inventing a second impulse
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root reaches a brief apex and keeps forward drift; knees and torso fold around it to clear the overhead plane

keys.label: TUCKED_UNDERPASS
keys.causal_role: the compact body travels beneath the clearance plane with both hands visibly clear and limbs deliberately phase-lagged
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root has begun gravity-earned descent; compression stays local and cannot flatten the root arc

keys.label: LATE_UNFOLD_DROP
keys.causal_role: clearance debt forces a late unfold; the right arm drops early because the feet are still folded behind
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root drops faster while advancing; right palm path steepens toward ground as legs begin to extend

keys.label: PALM_PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: right palm reaches under the forward chest before either foot can own support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues down-right; palm is near ground while both feet remain late and non-supporting

keys.label: RIGHT_PALM_FIRST
keys.causal_role: right palm acquires the first ground constraint but cannot arrest the body's down-forward COM
keys.motion_arc_root_note: hand contact changes support topology while root continues down/forward into the brace

keys.label: PALM_LEFT_FOOT_CATCH
keys.causal_role: left foot arrives late, creating an asymmetric two-point brace while the torso still dives past both anchors
keys.motion_arc_root_note: left foot catches forward-left of the pelvis; root sinks farther and chest crosses the new support diagonal

keys.label: TRIPOD_DEBT_CRUSH
keys.causal_role: both feet join the planted hand in a low tripod crush that pays delayed landing and forward-overturn debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root reaches the lowest grounded point; torso folds across the planted hand while knees compress unequally

keys.label: HAND_RELEASE_LEG_TAKEOVER
keys.causal_role: grounded legs take over support before the hand releases, preventing a magical pop-up
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root rises only slightly after leg support is established; right hand peels late and low

keys.label: CROSSBODY_REBOUND_LAG
keys.causal_role: ground reaction rebounds the root while the formerly planted arm remains low and the opposite shoulder overshoots
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root rebounds up/right; torso counter-swings opposite the crush while right arm visibly trails

keys.label: DISPLACED_CROUCH_EXIT
keys.causal_role: readiness returns at a new address with residual shoulder asymmetry and a low base rather than idle reset
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root settles forward of launch; arms and shoulders remain unequal, preserving recovery debt

tango_rounds.highest_value_visible_defect: At EARLY_CLEARANCE_READ/TUCKED_UNDERPASS an ASCII hand merged with the overhead plane, visually implying an unmodeled ceiling contact/force rather than clean shape-only clearance.
tango_rounds.correction: Re-author A022-K3 task-side hand and A022-K5 trailing hand/elbow lower inside the silhouette so every airborne body point clears the plane; preserve the same ballistic root arc and support state NONE.

tango_rounds.highest_value_visible_defect: After the hand fix, EARLY_CLEARANCE_READ still rounded the head glyph onto the overhead line, so the task read as a head strike rather than a clean near-miss.
tango_rounds.correction: Lower the authored A022-K3 head/chest one ASCII row while keeping the same root position, so the clearance read stays close but no body glyph occupies the constraint row.

tango_rounds.finding: Final actual render reads as one canted launch and ballistic arc; the body compacts cleanly beneath the overhead plane without accidental contact, unfolds late into a palm-first brace, adds left foot then both feet while COM continues down-forward, pays the landing in a deep three-point crush, releases the hand only after leg support is real, rebounds with right-arm lag, and exits displaced.

noodle_queen.taste: open rise → sharp ceiling tuck → late unfold → palm-first brace → tripod crush is a specific memorable silhouette chain
noodle_queen.function: shape-only clearance preserves one root arc; delayed landing preparation causally forces a hand-first support cascade and recovery debt
noodle_queen.contempt: no hover, accidental ceiling contact, symmetric placeholder landing, reverse interpolation, instant pop-up, or idle reset survives
